title: Mycobacterium tuberculosis DNA Extraction Using InstaGene Matrix and High Speed Homogenizer
author: Emilyn C Conceição
materials: Mycobacterial culture preparation and heat-inactivation (In the BSL3).
Pre-treatment of the heat-inactivated culture before DNA extraction.
DNA extraction using InstaGene matrix and bead-beating.
Purification with AMPure XP Bead-Based Reagent (Beckman Coulter) (Optional for WGS).

Prepare cultured samples, reagents, and review the equipment and consumable list before beginning the DNA extraction process. The method includes the following five sections: 1) Mycobacterial culture preparation and heat-inactivation (In the BSL3). 2) Pre-treatment of the heat-inactivated culture before DNA extraction. 3) DNA extraction using InstaGene matrix and bead-beating. 4) DNA quality control. 5) Purification with AMPure XP Bead-Based Reagent (Beckman Coulter) (Optional for WGS).

steps.title: Sample Preparation (BSL3)
steps.instruction: Prepare the clinical primary culture (CPC) Mycobacterial culture sample in a BSL3 facility.

substeps.instruction: Perform quality control (QC) using the rapid immunochromatographic assay (antigen test, Capilia TB-Neo assay) for MTBC detection.

steps.title: Processing Solid Culture (BSL3 to BSL2)
steps.instruction: Process solid culture samples for heat inactivation and transfer.

substeps.instruction: Label 1.5 or 2 mL tubes (containing 3 sterile beads of 2 mm) with sample identification.
Add 200 µL of nuclease-free water (NFW) to the labelled tubes (can be done in BSL2).
In a Level II laminar flow hood, scrape 1 loop size (10 μL) of mycobacterial culture into the labelled tubes.
Vortex tubes until clumped cells are dispersed.
Heat-inactivate samples at 80 °C for 01:00:00.
Wipe the outer surface of each tube and transfer to a BSL2 laboratory.

steps.title: Processing Liquid Culture (BSL3 to BSL2)
steps.instruction: Process liquid culture (BBL MGIT) samples for heat inactivation and transfer.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the MGIT tube (liquid culture in 7H9 MGIT media) for approximately 00:00:05 until bacterial biomass is homogenized and clumped cells are dispersed.
Transfer 5 mL of the BBL MGIT content into a labelled 15 mL polypropylene tube using a 2 or 3 mL Pasteur pipette; discard the pipette.
Place the 5 mL aliquoted culture into a pre-heated oven at 80 °C and inactivate for 01:00:00.
Wipe the outer surface of the tube and transfer to a BSL2 laboratory.

steps.title: Liquid Culture Pre-treatment (BSL2)
steps.instruction: Perform a saline wash and DNase I digestion to remove contaminating extracellular DNA from liquid cultures.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 15 mL tubes at 4,000 x g for 00:30:00 at Room temperature.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant using a Pasteur pipette without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet by adding 5 mL of 1X DNase buffer and vortex for 00:00:10.
Centrifuge again at 4,000 x g for 00:30:00 at Room temperature.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant using a Pasteur pipette, then remove remaining supernatant with a P1000 pipette.

Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL of 1X DNase buffer: resuspend in 350 µL, transfer to a 1.5 or 2 mL low-binding screw cap tube, then add 150 µL of 1X DNase buffer to the remaining pellet in the 15 mL tube and transfer to the same low-binding tube.
Add 10 µL of DNase I enzyme (15 U/µL, totalling 150 U per sample).
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:30:00 with gentle shaking.
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:10:00 to deactivate the enzyme.
Centrifuge at 21,000 rcf (full speed) for 00:20:00 to pellet cells.
Discard the supernatant carefully using a P200 or P100 pipette.

steps.title: DNA Extraction Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the extraction reagents and tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare batches of 1.5 or 2 mL low-binding screw-cap tubes containing three 2 mm beads and autoclave them.
Remove InstaGene Matrix (IGM) from refrigeration (4 °C), allow to equilibrate to Room temperature for at least 00:30:00, and homogenize using a magnetic mixer per manufacturer's guidelines.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and DNA Release
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the InstaGene Matrix and high-speed homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: For liquid culture (if pre-treatment was skipped): centrifuge 15 mL tubes at 4,000 x g for 00:30:00 at Room temperature. For solid culture: centrifuge 1.5 or 2 mL tubes at 12,000 rcf for 00:01:00 and remove supernatant without resuspending.
Gently resuspend the cell pellet with a P200 pipette and transfer the entire suspension to the pre-labelled tube containing the three beads.
Add 200 µL of well-mixed IGM to the sample.
Incubate at 56 °C for 00:15:00.
Homogenize using a vortex for 00:00:10.
Incubate in a heating block at 100 °C for 00:08:00.
Homogenize using an HSH (FastPrep or BeadBlaster 24) with program: 00:01:00 at 4.0 m/s, 1 cycle.
Centrifuge at 12,000 rcf for 00:15:00.
Transfer 130 µL of the supernatant to a 1.5 or 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Optional DNA Purification (AMPure XP)
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using AMPure XP beads if high levels of salt or protein contamination are present.

substeps.instruction: Vortex cold (4 °C) AMPure XP beads to resuspend.
Aliquot the DNA sample into a low-binding tube and thaw to Room temperature for 00:30:00.
Add AMPure XP beads at a 1.2X volume ratio (e.g., 60 µL beads for 50 µL DNA).
Homogenize by pipetting up and down 10 times slowly.
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00.
Place in a magnetic rack for 00:05:00 until the supernatant is clear.
Carefully remove the supernatant without touching the beads.
Add 100 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol (or proportionally increase for larger volumes, e.g., 200 µL for 130 µL DNA) to the opposite side of the beads while on the rack.
Repeat the 80% ethanol wash twice. Use a P10 pipette to remove residual ethanol after the second wash.
Allow 80% ethanol to evaporate for about 00:05:00 (or 00:10:00 for larger volumes) until beads have a matte finish.
Immediately add 50 µL (or 25 µL for higher concentration) of NFW and resuspend beads.
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00.
Place on the magnetic rack for 00:05:00.
Transfer the eluted DNA supernatant to a newly labelled tube.

steps.title: Quality Control of Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Verify the quantity and purity of the extracted genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Measure double strand (ds) DNA quantity using the high-sensitivity (HS) Qubit kit per manufacturer's instructions.
Measure DNA purity using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer: target 260/280 ratio of 1.8 (acceptable 1.7-2.0) and 260/230 ratio between 1.8 and 2.2.
Ensure a minimum DNA concentration of 1.0 ng/µL for Illumina sequencing.
